surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the chemisorption of Ti and Pb precursors on predeposited layers, with the Ti precursor chemisorbing on the Pb–O layer and the Pb precursor chemisorbing on the Ti–O layer. The self-regulated growth behavior is influenced by the bonding site density and chemisorption activity on these layers, leading to a balanced Pb/Ti ratio.
